summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd., an Israeli clinical-stage pharmaceutical foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K covering interim results for the first half of 2026. The report attaches a business-update press release, condensed interim unaudited financial statements, and an operating and financial review as of June 30, 2026, each dated September 25, 2026. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory term is stated; this is a routine periodic reporting event, not a special situation, offering no deal spread to trade.
